issues.title: We allow message modifications, but do not store previous versions
issues.body:
## 🐞 Amendment description
In the `collab-message-detail` component we allow users to modify collab-messages.  We store the new state of the `message.message` content in the updated message.  But, an analyst wishes to analyse the changes in the message.

## 🔗 Affected page
`collab-message-detail\index.tsx`


## 🔢 Current behaviour
Only the updated message content is stored.

## ⚙️ Expected behavior
<!-- A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen. -->
A copy of the previous state of the `message.message` should be present in the `feedback` block.


## 🖥️ Screenshots
<!-- If applicable, add screenshots to help explain your problem a good animated screenshot can replace 'steps to reproduce'. -->

## 📝 Additional context
<!-- Add any other context about the problem here. For example it might be worth mentioning if you have any chrome extensions which may cause the problem -->
We could reduce space if we just stored the JSON diff that represents the change to the message.
